title: Brusque vs. Ferroviária: Decisive Clash in 2026 Série C
seoTitle: Brusque vs. Ferroviária: Decisive Série C Clash
subtitle: Match scheduled for Sunday at 6:30 p.m. at Arena Simon, with promotion on the line
excerpt: Brusque and Ferroviária face off this Sunday at Arena Simon in a match that could define promotion to the 2027 Série B.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brusque and Ferroviária meet again this Sunday at 6:30 p.m. (Brasília time) at Arena Simon, for the fourth round of the final qualifying stage of the 2026 Série C. The clash is highly anticipated as both teams fight for positions that can secure promotion to the 2027 Série B.

Brusque looks to bounce back

After losing to Ferroviária in the previous round, the Santa Catarina side has four points and sits in second place in Group C. The club aims to leverage their home-field advantage to return to winning ways and rejoin the fight for the top spots.

Ferroviária aims to maintain the lead

Winners of the previous match, Ferroviária entered the clash with seven points, leading Group C. Another victory could consolidate their lead and pave the way to securing promotion in the final stage.

Venue and broadcast

The match will take place at Arena Simon in Brusque, Santa Catarina. The live broadcast will be available on Canal do Benja/TMC (YouTube) and SportyNet+.

Predicted lineups

Manager Higo Magalhães is expected to keep the core of the previous victory, with Nogueira; Jeferson, João Maistro, Cipriano, and Raimar; Bernardo, Gazão, and Ariel (with a possible switch for Petterson); JP Martins, Adrianinho, and Marlyson. For Ferroviária, Rogério Corrêa's probable lineup is Denis Júnior; Felipe Rodrigues, Medina, Zé Vitor, and Oliveira; Carrilho, Alencar, and Juninho; Albano, Barreto, and Maranhão.

Match officials

The referee for the match will be Angleison Marcos Vieira Monteiro from Rondônia, assisted by Joverton Wesley De Souza Lima (RO) and Alex Sandro Quadros Thome (RR). The fourth official will be Eduardo de Carvalho Correa (SC), with Diego Pombo Lopez (BA) as the VAR and Luciano Roggenbaum (PR) as the AVAR.

With information from ge, Terra.
